STUDY 102
Cream Tee & Dark Wide Jeans
Rights check
Source: 24992.jpg
Relaxed, polished, classic
WORKING NOTES
- The navy script and wide jeans are the defining pieces.
- Add 'full-length' to keep the boots in frame.
Try this: Use full-length framing to include the boots.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, soft
brown waves stands full-length against a
warm tan backdrop. She wears a white
short-sleeve tee with a navy script
graphic, a pearl chain necklace, and
dark wide-leg jeans with patch pockets
and frayed hems. She holds a black tote
over one arm and wears black ankle
boots. Her expression is calm and direct.
Soft, even studio light. Palette of ivory,
navy, and warm tan. Relaxed and
polished, in the style of an autumn
catalog.
